# `WF2LOO-14` — Make until_dry read the progress_field its templates declare

## Intent — what this is for

An inert-control atom over WF2LOO-3's templates: until_dry termination measured something other than what the templates declare. controller._is_dry(output) returned True only when the output was None or len(output) == 0 and never looked at progress_field, and the output it was handed is the leaf that COMPLETED the iteration - in both declaring templates the judge stage, whose schema carries no progress key and which returns a populated object every time. So for the only two loops that asked for it, the mode's own exit could not fire on either count, and a run burned every iteration up to its cap paying for a model call each time to learn nothing. This atom makes the declared field decide, with one exhaustive per-type rule, and leaves every loop that declares no field byte-for-byte unchanged.

## Done when

controller._advance_loop decides dryness via _iteration_is_dry: a loop declaring progress_field is judged on THAT field (_progress_reading: None/False/0/blank/empty => dry; anything else including a negative number => progress; an unmapped type => unreadable, never swallowed by a default branch), and _progress_value finds it anywhere in the iteration's body - restricted to nodes whose instance for THIS iteration succeeded, since self._outputs is keyed by node id and holds the previous iteration's value for a node that did not run. Body-wide search is required, not preferred: both declaring templates emit the field from the FIRST stage of a sequence body and end the iteration on a judge stage, so a last-leaf-only read ships inert. A loop declaring no field keeps _is_dry's whole-output rule byte-for-byte; a declared field that is absent or of an unreadable type falls back to that rule rather than counting as dryness, because ending a run over a key the body forgot would silently truncate real work. streak semantics untouched (tick.loop_should_continue unchanged). template_lint.py's comment claiming 'progress_field merely names which field it reads' becomes true. Driven through a real controller on the shipped body shape: ends at 2 iterations on two zero-progress cycles; runs to the cap while progress is reported; a productive cycle resets the streak; an absent field runs to the cap. Rail over EVERY bundled template: a declared progress_field must appear in a body node's schema AND be named in that node's prompt. Both halves proven able to fail by probes (call site reverted to _is_dry => the two ending tests red; one template's field renamed => the rail red), each reverted by a targeted edit. CHANGELOG entry under Fixed: this changes when two shipped templates' runs end.
